sft79h1v.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Woodland Pine Hinged Branches Tree
sft79h1v.sourceDescription: One of our most realistic Christmas trees, the Woodland Pine has a "freshly cut" look. A bushy Christmas tree boasting dark green foliage and a mix of PE & PVC branch tips, the Woodland Pine has a charming realism to it that few artificial Christmas trees achieve. What's more, this 7ft pre-lit Christmas tree comes with LEDs already attached to the branches that's right, no more untangling Christmas lights! The tips are expertly moulded from real tree needles to create a greater degree of realism. You'll also find strong hinged branches on the Woodland Pine, making the tree easy to put up and bring down. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

xfeqv1rt.baseName: The Christmas Workshop 50 Shatterproof Christmas Baubles – Champagne
xfeqv1rt.variantName: The Christmas Workshop 50 Shatterproof Christmas Baubles – Champagne
xfeqv1rt.sourceDescription: Create a coordinated Christmas tree with this set of 50 champagne decorations. Mixed textures and a combination of round baubles and stars add detail, whether you’re building a single-colour display or pairing them with your favourite ornaments. The set includes 10 large 8cm baubles, 32 small 4cm baubles and 8 small stars. The different sizes help you balance your display across larger and smaller branches, while the lightweight, shatterproof plastic construction offers a practical alternative to glass. Each decoration comes with a pre-attached hanging string, so you can start dressing your tree straight away. The set arrives in a cardboard box that you can reuse to keep the decorations together when storing them after Christmas. Key Features Set of 50 champagne decorations with mixed designs and textures. Shatterproof plastic construction offers an alternative to glass. Lightweight design helps prevent branches from drooping. Pre-attached hanging strings for easy decorating. Includes 10 × 8cm baubles, 32 × 4cm baubles and 8 small stars. Supplied in a cardboard box for storage between festive seasons. Please refer to product packaging Benross Marketing , 22 goodlass road , l24 9hj
